summary: Petition to quash chargesheet for IPC s. 323, 406, 498A, 506; wife's allegations of dowry demand, physical abuse, marital cruelty, and illegal detention; husband's criminal complaint; HC order declining quashment; standard of prima facie case; court finding sufficiency of allegations for trial; oral evidence excluded in quashment proceedings.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; HC order upholding chargesheet maintained.
